name: atlas-guest-portal
description: Atlas Homestays guest-facing frontend for property discovery and booking

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/verify-lockfile-linux-ci-deps.mjs && npm run validate:legal && node tools/optimize-images.mjs && node tools/generate-sitemap.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/verify-pages-env.mjs && node scripts/verify-well-known-config-precedence.mjs && vite build && node scripts/write-version-json.mjs
scripts.test:gate: node scripts/vitest-isolated-batch-pool.self-test.mjs && node scripts/vitest-gate-batch-hygiene.self-test.mjs && cross-env ATLAS_VITEST_GATE_BATCH=1 node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.validate:legal: cross-env CI=1 node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.legal.config.ts --bail=1

//optionalDependencies: DOC KEY, not read by npm: a top-level key that is not a dependency block. See the '//overrides' note below for why these docs exist (ENG-003, 2026-10-07).

These three exist only so the Windows-generated package-lock.json carries the Linux x64 native binaries that Cloudflare Pages `npm ci` needs. `prebuild` runs scripts/verify-lockfile-linux-ci-deps.mjs, which FAILS the build if their node_modules/... entries are missing from the lockfile (it checks presence, not version).

@img/sharp-linux-x64 = 0.35.4 and @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64 = 1.3.3 (exact). WHY: must equal what the installed `sharp` (devDependency ^0.35.4, used by tools/optimize-images.mjs in prebuild) lists in its own optionalDependencies. ON BUMP of sharp: run `npm view sharp@<new> optionalDependencies`, move both pins to those exact versions, regenerate the lockfile and confirm both linux entries are still present. wrangler -> miniflare nests its own sharp@0.35.2 and is unaffected.

@rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu = 4.63.1 (exact). WHY: nothing else in the tree asks for it any more (vite 8 bundles with rolldown; `npm ls rollup` is empty, checked 2026-10-07). Kept only because verify-lockfile-linux-ci-deps.mjs still lists it as required. ON BUMP of vite/vitest there is no version to match; if you drop this pin, drop it from that script's `required` list in the same commit.
//overrides: DOC KEY, not read by npm. JSON has no comments, so every pin below is explained here, one line per entry, in the same order. Do NOT put a `//` key inside `overrides` itself: npm reads each key there as a package name.

READ FIRST (ENG-003): an override silently REPLACES the range a consumer asks for, and Dependabot bumps the consumer without ever touching the pin. On 2026-10-06 vitest 4.1.11 -> 5.0.2 (PR #574) pulled magic-string@1.4.2, which needs sourcemap-codec ^1.6.0 while the pin said 1.5.5: vitest AND `npm run build` died at module load, the only red was the Cloudflare Pages check, and dev deployed nothing for ~18 h (fixed forward in 6e12de0a).

ON ANY BUMP of a consumer named below: (1) `npm view <consumer>@<new> dependencies` and compare its range for the pinned package with the pin; (2) `npm ls <pinned-pkg>` and read every `overridden` row; (3) run `npm ci && npm run build && npm test`. A red Cloudflare Pages BUILD on a package.json/lockfile-only PR is a real failure, not noise.

@jridgewell/sourcemap-codec = 1.6.0 (EXACT, not a range). WHY: one copy of the source-map codec across the tree. Pinned 1.5.5 in 76b30aa8 (Nov 2025, with the Node toolchain pin; that commit gives no further reason), raised to 1.6.0 in 6e12de0a because vitest@5's magic-string@1.4.2 asks ^1.6.0. Other consumers ask ^1.4.10..^1.5.5 (@jridgewell/gen-mapping, trace-mapping, magic-string@0.30 via @tailwindcss/node, miniflare's trace-mapping). ON BUMP of vitest, vite, @vitest/mocker, magic-string or @tailwindcss/node: run `npm view magic-string@<new> dependencies.@jridgewell/sourcemap-codec` and raise this pin FIRST if anything asks for more than 1.6.0 (an exact pin forces every consumer down to it). Symptom if missed: "does not provide an export named 'encodeRangeMappings'" when vitest or the build starts.

@xmldom/xmldom ^0.9.12 (caret on 0.x = >=0.9.12 <0.10.0). WHY: security floor, 0.9.0-beta.1..0.9.11 carry High advisories (TASK-101865, bee872f0). Reached only through @capacitor/cli -> plist@3.1.1 (asks ^0.9.10): build-time iOS/Android tooling, not shipped. ON BUMP of @capacitor/cli or plist: `npm view plist@<new> dependencies.@xmldom/xmldom`; if plist now asks >=0.9.12 the override can go, and if it asks 0.10+ this cap forces plist onto an older major.

dom-accessibility-api ^0.6.3. WHY: keeps ONE copy. @testing-library/dom@10.4.1 asks ^0.5.9 and @testing-library/jest-dom@7 asks ^0.6.3; without the pin npm nests 0.5.16 under testing-library/dom (lock-only resolve, 2026-10-07). Added in 1082a315 (Feb 2026) while fixing validate:legal and test failures; that commit does not name the failure. ON BUMP of @testing-library/dom or jest-dom: if both now ask ^0.6 the pin is redundant (remove it, run `npm ci && npm test`); if either moves to a different minor, re-check that the jest-dom accessible-name matchers still pass.

minimatch >=10.2.1 (open-ended upper bound). WHY: security floor from 972f2f83 (Feb 2026, landed with the eslint 10 / glob 13 move; the commit does not name the advisory, so run `npm audit` before lowering it). Every current consumer (eslint, @eslint/config-array, glob, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree) already asks ^10.2.x, so today this only guarantees the floor. ON BUMP of eslint, glob or typescript-eslint: there is NO ceiling, so a new minimatch major can be pulled onto ^10 consumers when one is re-resolved; check `npm ls minimatch` against each consumer's range.

undici ^7.29.0. WHY: High CVEs in undici < 7.28 (TASK-4187, 476c9307, Jun 2026), reached via jsdom and wrangler -> miniflare, dev tooling only (nothing in src/ or functions/ imports undici). DRIFT TO KNOW: jsdom@30.0.1 now asks undici ^8.9.0 and this override holds it on 7.29.0 (without the pin a lock-only resolve gives jsdom its own undici 8.11.2); miniflare@5.20260908.0-alpha pins undici 7.29.0 exactly. ON BUMP of jsdom, wrangler or miniflare: compare their undici range with ^7.29.0; if `npm test` breaks after a jsdom bump suspect this pin first, and it is the candidate to drop for jsdom.

uuid ^11.1.1. WHY: clears the High/Moderate advisory chain @capacitor/cli -> xcode@3.0.1 (asks uuid ^7.0.3) -> uuid (d0300e2a, 2026-09-09). Build-time tooling only: uuid is not imported by src/ or in the shipped bundle, and xcode only calls uuid.v4(), which is why the 7 -> 11 jump is safe. ON BUMP of @capacitor/cli or xcode: `npm view xcode@<new> dependencies.uuid`; if it asks ^8+ the pin can go. If `npx cap sync ios` or `cap add ios` fails with a uuid error, suspect this pin.
//devDependencies: DOC KEY, not read by npm. The only deliberate pin in this block is typescript ~6.0.3. WHY: typescript-eslint's peer range is >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 and its guard throws at module import, so TS 6.1+ or 7 takes lint out entirely (dc3bd1ac bumped TS to 7.0.2 and failed the release gate at STEP 1/9; reverted in 622e8337). Dependabot REWRITES the declared range when it bumps, so this pin is not enough alone: the `ignore` rule for typescript in .github/dependabot.yml covers the Dependabot path, and both are needed. ON BUMP of typescript-eslint: re-read its peer range before lifting either.
